background_observer.boundary: A timer/maintenance loop, not introspection or consciousness.

base_model_weight_change.boundary: No model training or weight updates.

candidate_code_selection.boundary: Selects only host-supplied code candidates in the restricted worker.

consciousness_or_feelings.boundary: State labels are heuristic numbers, not subjective experience.

embedded_host_bridge.boundary: The host chat generates the answer between begin-turn and commit-turn.

epistemic_event_chain.boundary: Local SHA-256 chain; no external signature authority.

external_llm_bridge.boundary: A real provider is active only when the host supplies one.

full_state_relay.boundary: Snapshot import requires the same schema version.

hidden_cross_chat_memory.boundary: No hidden memory outside the retained database/snapshot.

persistent_state.boundary: Only while the SQLite file is retained.

research_adapter.boundary: Internet is used only when connected evidence proves a network request.

strategy_learning.boundary: Learns routing features; proposed descendants require a blind holdout gate.
